75:t_1:57.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're heading for the $$アメリア$$ Continent...!」

75:t_1:58.en:
$$勝平$$
「And we'll defeat $$サイデリアル$$ there!!」

75:t_1:59.en:
$$レド$$
「You heard them, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. This is my answer.」

75:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Acknowledged. As your $$パイロット支援啓発インターフェイス$$, this unit respects your decision.」

75:t_1:61.en:
$$レド$$
(I'm off, $$ベベル$$... And you, $$ガルガンティア船団$$...)

75:t_1:62.en:
$$レド$$
(Someday, I'll come back with $$エイミー$$... By then, I want to be able to believe I need myself, too...)

75:t_10:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't stop thinking about that man $$ギルター$$, whom we fought again today...」

75:t_10:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That man $$ギルター$$... He seems to fight out of personal feelings... Hatred, rather than duty...」

75:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, you've noticed something interesting. I think you're right.」

75:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... That's a characteristic of that unit...」

75:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But hatred is a human emotion, too... Thanks to it, destroying that man's ship produced high-quality $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

75:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Their value... 100Z. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

75:t_10:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You really... can't think about anything but $$Ｚチップ$$s, can you, $$ＡＧ$$?」

75:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally. $$Ｚチップ$$s are the key to saving the world.」

75:t_10:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I was an idiot to ask.」

75:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, Miss $$スズネ$$. Please calm down.」

75:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If someone as insignificant as $$ギルター$$ scares you, you'll never be able to fight on the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

75:t_10:22.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You can try to frighten me like that, but I'm not falling for it anymore.」

75:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(There is some truth to what I'm saying... Well, frightening her unnecessarily wouldn't help, so I'll leave it at that.)

75:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, Miss $$スズネ$$. I'm... counting on you.)

75:t_10:30.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Wow! There are talking machines besides $$チェインバー#pilot$$ and $$アル$$!」

75:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I am $$ＡＧ$$... A Customer Support Enlightenment Interface.」

75:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In short, I'm an agent robot for a dimension trader.」

75:t_10:34.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't understand. That doesn't explain anything.」

75:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't worry about it. That was a dimension joke.」

75:t_10:36.en:
$$レド$$
「Now I understand even less...! What's a dimension joke...!?」

75:t_10:37.en:
$$エイミー$$
($$レド$$... $$ガロード$$ said we should avoid getting too involved with this machine...)

75:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$レド$$, if you want to understand someone, one way is to try behaving as they do first.」

75:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go, then. Are you ready?」

75:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's get fired up again today...!」

75:t_10:51.en:
$n
「It's good to be straightforward, but at this rate he'll just become $$ＡＧ$$'s plaything.」

75:t_10:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「We can't leave everything to $$チェインバー#pilot$$ after all.」

75:t_10:55.en:
$n
「We'll help him learn to smile like a human being.」

75:t_10:56.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's a fine attitude, both of you.」

75:t_10:57.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So being called the quiet type really did bother them deep down.」

75:t_10:58.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hehe... Good luck, $n, $$宗介$$. And you too, $$レド$$.」

76:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The sea around here is blue...」

76:t_000:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「There aren't many $$ヒカリムシ$$ here. Basically, we're already off the fleet's shipping routes.」

76:t_000:3.en:
$$ミーナ#pt169$$
「They're nanomachines in the sea that generate electricity and emit light. They're why the seas on this Earth look green.」

76:t_000:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「So those $$ヒカリムシ$$ are what make the sea glow at midnight.」

76:t_000:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Apparently, after the $$残されの海$$ was transported here, the $$ヒカリムシ$$ spread from it to the seas all over the world.」

76:t_000:7.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s research suggests the opposite. Apparently, $$ヒカリムシ$$ purify pollutants in the sea.」

76:t_000:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Nanomachines that purify the sea...」

76:t_000:9.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, $$エイミー$$, $$ピニオン$$... Thank you for coming this far to see us off.」

76:t_000:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Don't mention it. You've done a lot for us.」

76:t_000:11.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Besides... $$レド$$ and I wanted to say a proper goodbye to everyone...」

76:t_000:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. A group of units is approaching this area.」

76:t_000:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Their identification signals indicate $$サイデリアル$$.」

76:t_001:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Tch...! Running into them while we're on the move...!」

76:t_001:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「But if fate brought us together, I'll follow its lead and crush them!」

76:t_001:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$'s unit, huh?」

76:t_001:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, launch! He's coming after us!」

76:t_002:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, please take $$エイミー$$ and the others somewhere safe.」
